All 4 pytest cases pass and the full UI flow (login → sidebar → tabs → contact dialog → send message → redirect) works on the public preview URL.

backend.GET /api/tutoring-requests/open (EDUCATO: 200 — results[] contains requester_name (str) + match_score (int), no _id leak

action_items: Optional a11y: add <DialogDescription> to Opportunities contact dialog to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py GET /tutoring-requests/open: per-doc await db.users.find_one inside a loop — N+1 query pattern. For scale, batch requester_user_ids and $in-query users, or aggregate with $lookup.
Opportunities.jsx: catch blocks swallow errors silently for GET (setJobs([]) / setRequests([])). Consider a toast/inline error so users can distinguish empty state vs. network failure.
Opportunities.jsx: no auth/role guard on the client component — relies on route/sidebar to gate. Server correctly enforces EDUCATOR-only, so acceptable.
